thread:
Priya (Marketing): Quick sync — next Tues micro-event. Finalizing registration iframe embed + heatmap tracking + Zoom SRT capture handoff. Need owners for: iframe confirm, Zoom record settings, lead routing Zap, transcript flow. Who can own which?

Jules (Growth): I can own lead routing & HubSpot tag mapping. Will create UTM -> HubSpot property mapping. Quick Q: do we mark leads as 'attended' on Zoom webhook or after recording processed?

Ari (Events): I can own greenroom & Zoom ops. Preference: cloud recording + local disk backup. We'll stream SRT to post-prod for captions. Need filename convention for recordings. Also scheduling for dry run.

Noah (Ops): Ops will set RTMP fallback and retention. For Zoom settings: enable `Allow live streaming to custom service`, enable `Audio transcript` and `SRT` output. Local recording as fallback. Disk space check >= 100GB.

Zoe (Design): I'll supply the iframe embed creative + 3 CTA variants. Heatmap snippet will be the data layer we inject. Example iframe we plan to use: <iframe src=\"https://events.redwood.com/reg?event=scalebench\" width=\"100%\" height=\"720\" frameborder=\"0\"></iframe>. Will add `data-utm` attrs for easier mapping.

Jules (Growth): Mapping notes: `utm_source=webinar`, `utm_campaign=scalebench-mar2026`, `utm_medium=embed`. HubSpot tag: `webinar_reg:scalebench`. I'll build the Zap to tag by `registrant.email`.

Jules (Growth): For attended flag — recommend: mark `attended=true` when we receive Zoom `webinar.participant_left` + `duration > 5` OR when `recording.processed` webhook confirms. Safer to use recording confirmation for downstream clip routing.

Ari (Events): Recording filename convention: `scalebench_<env>_<YYYYMMDD>_<session>` e.g. `scalebench_prod_20260331_microlab.mp4`. SRT filename: same with `.srt`. Post-prod needs that stable pattern.

Noah (Ops): Zapier flow (high level): Zoom webhook -> upload recording to S3 -> POST to our ingestion endpoint -> HubSpot engagement + assign rep if `utm_campaign=scalebench`. Pseudo-webhook payload:
POST https://hooks.redwood-internal.com/webinar-end
{
  "meeting_id":"{{meetingId}}",
  "recording_url":"{{recordingFiles[0].download_url}}",
  "srt_url":"{{recordingFiles[0].srt_url}}",
  "attendee_count":"{{participant_count}}"
}

Zoe (Design): I'll also produce a replay thumbnail + 10s clip (GIF) for email. Need the SRT so we can pull captions for GIF subtitles. ETA for assets: Fri EOD.

Priya (Marketing): Post-event follow-up timeline: 0-24h send replay to registrants; 48-72h send 3 clips + CTA; 7d nurture. Who's drafting copy?

Zoe (Design): I can draft the short replay email copy + subject line options (3 variants). Will hand to Jules for personalization tokens.

Jules (Growth): I'll wire HubSpot sequences: sample token `{{first_name}}`, add rep assignment rule: if `company_revenue > 1M` then assign AE, else SDR. Also will add `viewed_replay` workflow once asset hit S3.

Ari (Events): Greenroom checklist (dry run Fri 9am PT): mic check, camera framing, captions enabled, streaming to SRT ingest test, local backup drive attached, slide deck upload. I'll invite ops + design + 2 hosts.

Noah (Ops): RTMP fallback: we will use `rtmp://fallback.redwood.com/scalebench/<session>` if Zoom streaming fails. Retention policy: cloud recordings + SRT kept 30 days, S3 copies retained 180 days.

Priya (Marketing): Reporting needs: heatmap snapshot + registration conversion by iframe variant, attendee % by utm_campaign, clip CTRs. Add a small note to email CTA to capture trial signups.

Jules (Growth): I'll add tracking: heatmap tool -> daily export to drive + mapping into growth dashboard. Also will add a hidden `data-variant` attr on the iframe for split analysis.

Ari (Events): Dry run invite sent. Also want a short escalation plan if recording fails: fallback to manual local upload to S3 and mark `manual=true` in metadata.

Zoe (Design): Reminder on accessibility: auto captions on cloud recording + human-proof transcripts before publishing. I will flag any long jargon for edit.

Noah (Ops): deploy-bot: recording-upload-test: https://s3.redwood.com/scalebench/1766000000/test-recording.mp4 :white_check_mark:

Priya (Marketing): Perfect — owners: Lead routing = Jules, Zoom ops & greenroom = Ari, Ops infra + RTMP = Noah, Embed + heatmap + creative = Zoe. I'll update the event runbook and ping when copy/iframes are live. :thumbsup:

Jules (Growth): I'll post the zap flow link and HubSpot playbook once created.

Ari (Events): I'll post the dry-run notes after Fri and close the loop on filename & SRT ingest path.

deploy-bot: Recording processed and available at https://s3.redwood.com/scalebench/1766000000/scalebench_prod_20260331_microlab.mp4

Priya (Marketing): Thanks all — filing this thread into the runbook. Follow-ups: Zoe to share assets by Fri, Jules to publish zap, Ari to confirm dry run results.
